blocks.title: Research Interests
blocks.data:
Working at the intersection of machine learning and design — how intelligent systems can be made more interpretable, accessible and human-centred. Currently exploring anomaly detection in time-series data and multimodal learning.

Open to collaborations on applied ML research, especially in sustainability and education.
